Please provide a clear and concise description of the changes:
- What problem does this PR solve?
- What approach was taken?
- Any side effects or risks?

## 🔗 Related Issues / NFRs
- Closes #<issue-number>
- References: <NFR link if applicable>

## ✅ Checklist
Please confirm the following before requesting review:

- [ ] Scope ≤300 LOC
- [ ] Tests/docs updated
- [ ] CI checks are green
- [ ] No secrets or credentials committed
- [ ] Screenshots included for UI changes
- [ ] Linked to relevant issue(s) and NFRs
- [ ] Review requested from CODEOWNERS

- AI assistance used: **Yes / No**
- If yes, describe briefly (e.g., “drafted PR description”)

Attach screenshots or short clips for UI changes.

## 🗣️ Review Notes
Add any context reviewers should know (e.g., testing steps, known limitations).
